data.narrative:
Deterrence is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $10M+. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable set of 10 companies (2 public, 8 private) in the same sector and stage, including peers UFORCE, Singularity, and NODA AI, with a broader reference universe spanning Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $10M raised as a proxy for current value, applying a 2.5x multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage progression, yielding $25M. Peer-median analysis across the 3 closest comparables (UFORCE at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, NODA AI at $125M) produces a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B. The divergence reflects the heterogeneity inherent in early-stage Defense & Security valuations, where company maturity, customer traction, and defensibility vary significantly.

Triangulation of both methods suggests a valuation range of $21M to $460M, with a median of $212M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around Deterrence's market position relative to peers. Critical unknowns include the company's customer pipeline, technical differentiation versus the broader peer set, and capital efficiency relative to stage-comparable companies. The Stage-progression method anchors a conservative floor; the Peer-median approach captures upside potential if Deterrence is positioned similarly to higher-valued comparables.
